vision.name: Krillin
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Whenever a Setup enters play under your control, gain 2 stages. Whenever a Setup or Drill enters play under your control during combat, Rejuvenate 1 and banish the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.
POWER: [Attack] 2: Energy attack.
You may use this attack a second time this combat.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for a Setup or Drill and place it into play.
vision.note: promo with the normal booster layout; filename ends in ' copy'; edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badge E (blue); top stage printed 1,000,100 (zoomed; looks like a printed oddity, kept as printed); stage cost printed as '2:'; text zoomed
